style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, high mountain noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses the lens or fills it: a bill, her tail, the marmot's face, the herd, the paper. Lens fully blanked seven times. The banner snaps in the wind all clip
camera_moves: wide; close-ups come from the animals and the paper
character: a lean puma in a rich embroidered coat, lounging in a gilded velvet armchair, half-closed golden eyes, a huge DIAMOND RING sparking on her finger, bills under one paw, an iron chain in the other; she never hurries
cast: the MARMOT: fat, chewing without pause, never running, on a chain like a lapdog at her chair. The HERD: goats and deer at full speed, never stopping
props: BANNER: a ragged holed cloth on poles over the cliff, flapping hard; on it a painted smiling top-hatted showman and a cartoon THREE-FINGERED hand making a profit sign. CHAIR: carved gold, red velvet, absurd on bare rock. BILLS: pale slips, percent shape
prop_continuity: the stack shrinks: full at 0.0, half at 4.2, gone at 8.0; the ring catches the sun in every shot
environment: sunlit ledge, wind-raked grass, blue sky, valley ending in a sheer drop
lighting: blazing high-altitude noon, hard sun, crisp shadows, glints off the diamond

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: lazy satisfied female voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: pauses only at 1.3-1.6, 3.0-4.2 and 7.0-7.5; the 4.2 and 5.6 lines run together; voiceless after 8.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: cloth cracking, paper rustle, chain clinking, chewing; a body thud at 3.0; at 5.6-7.0 loud bleating and thunder of hooves, fading after 8.8

timeline.a: silent. A bill flies INTO THE LENS, blanks the frame, peels away: she is deep in the gilded chair, the torn banner cracking above
she leans out of the chair at the lens until her face fills the frame; the ring throws a spark into the camera
silent. The chain snaps taut across the frame, a bill spins past the lens
she turns her whole body in the chair, tail sweeping across the lens; the wind bellies the banner over the whole frame
silent, the loudest hit. The fat MARMOT slams into the lens on his chain, chewing face covering the entire frame, then the stack bursts up around him and blanks the frame twice
she stretches full length out of the chair as the wind drags the last paper across the whole frame
no breath. The herd tears edge to edge under the banner in a wall of dust, bleating, hooves hammering
silent, the only stop. Nothing moves but the marmot's jaw, the cloth and the ring
she whips her head into the lens, muzzle filling the frame, eyes opening wide
silent. She sweeps the last bills over the edge; through the paper the herd reaches the drop and the first goats go over
silent. She rises from the chair in one graceful movement and looks down: the back rows shove the front ones and the herd pours into the abyss one after another, the banner smiling over them

must_appear: the diamond ring sparking, the gilded chair on bare rock, the marmot chained like a lapdog, the holed banner with the showman and the three-fingered sign, her graceful rise at the end, the herd falling into the abyss
negative_prompt: letters, numbers, cyrillic, words on the banner, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, live people, blood, gore, a second puma, slow motion, speed ramp, the herd standing still, the chain breaking, a clean unbroken banner, a talking head with nothing else moving, silence in the tail, accented Russian
